hero.headline:
Eight people. Two acres.
One decision that was going to take three months and took a weekend.

spaces.name: Roof Deck
spaces.desc: Open to the sky above Lazy Lake. Where conversations find their widest perspective.

spaces.name: Outdoor Dining
spaces.desc: Where meals become meetings and the boundary between conversation and open air dissolves.

spaces.name: Indoor Dining
spaces.desc: Contained and considered. The formal gathering point where ideas are laid alongside everything else.

spaces.name: Living Room
spaces.desc: The gravitational heart of the house. Comfortable enough for real talk. Open enough for the unexpected.

spaces.name: Fire Pit
spaces.desc: Some conversations need darkness and light in equal measure. The fire pit holds both.

spaces.name: Breakout Spaces
spaces.desc: Smaller pockets throughout the property for the conversations that happen at the edge of the main event.

pricing.name: Private Use
pricing.desc: Use the space as your own — bring your people, your purpose, and let the environment do its work. Includes full property access: the Skydeck, Al Fresco, the Table, the Center, the Flame, the Margins. The setting shapes the conversation. You guide it.
pricing.rate: A day rate, scoped to your gathering. Shared directly when we speak.

pricing.name: Curated Experience
pricing.desc: A more intentional shaping of the day — how conversations flow, where energy gathers, and how the space supports it. Structure meets spontaneity.
pricing.rate: Priced for the day we design together. Discussed when we speak.

pricing.name: Facilitated Sessions
pricing.desc: For those seeking deeper clarity or alignment. Direct work with Mark to surface what matters, refine direction, and move things forward.
pricing.rate: A bespoke engagement with Mark. Defined around what you need.

testimonials.quote: "We came in with an agenda. We left with something better — a shared understanding we couldn't have planned for."
